question: How much material did Vesuvius throw out in ten days in 1944?
answer: Vesuvius threw out more than 245 million m³ of material in ten days. That much would fill a cube about 626 m on each side. Falling ash and lapilli damaged towns including Pompei, Nocera, Scafati and Poggiomarino.
move: Ten times wider holds a thousand times more: big volumes hide in small cubes.

web.label: A 3D cube the reader drags up or down until it holds the material Vesuvius erupted in its first ten days in 1944, more than 245 million cubic metres.
